title: Home address delivery
summary: Home couriers: Colissimo, Chronopost, Mondial Relay home. Registers methods on the cart.
configure: Admin, Plugins, Home address delivery, Configure. Packet prices (scalar or per-country) edit courier_packets.price.
cart: Checkout shows these couriers when the plugin is on and the delivery country is enabled. Prices come from packet rows on Configure.
orders: The chosen courier code is stored on the order. shipping-expedition-cron complements tracking later.
profile: Customer addresses are core. This plugin only consumes the delivery address.

sections.heading: How a courier plugin registers on the cart
paragraphs: Set courierCodes on the manifest. Core checkout lists enabled couriers whose plugin is effectively on. PATCH /admin/plugins/:id { rates } writes packet prices. See the Courier in cart worked example.
